_meta.definition: The unifying capability across all tables is the management and maintenance of customer records, interactions, and transactions.

customer._description: Captures customer demographic and transactional data, including personal details, preferences, and historical interactions.

columns.name: c_customer_sk
columns.description: Stores unique identifiers for each customer record.

columns.name: c_customer_id
columns.description: Foreign key linking to the c_customer_ entity

columns.name: c_current_cdemo_sk
columns.description: Stores sequential surrogate keys for current demographic groups of customers.

columns.name: c_current_hdemo_sk
columns.description: Stores sequential identifiers for active customers in the current hierarchy demo.

columns.name: c_current_addr_sk
columns.description: Stores unique identifiers for current customer addresses.

columns.name: c_first_shipto_date_sk
columns.description: Stores unique integer keys for the first ship-to date of each customer.

columns.name: c_first_sales_date_sk
columns.description: Stores sequential integer keys for the first sales dates of customers.

columns.name: c_salutation
columns.description: Stores customer's formal title (e.g., Mr., Dr., Miss) up to 10 characters.

columns.name: c_first_name
columns.description: Stores up to 50 characters of a customer's first name.

columns.name: c_last_name
columns.description: Stores up to 50 characters of the last names for customers.

columns.name: c_preferred_cust_flag
columns.description: Indicates whether a customer is preferred (Y) or not (N).

columns.name: c_birth_day
columns.description: Stores customer birthdays as integers (e.g., day of month).

columns.name: c_birth_month
columns.description: Stores the month of birth for customers (12, 4, 9, 6, 5 represent December, April, September, June, and May respectively).

columns.name: c_birth_year
columns.description: Stores the birth year of customers as integers.

columns.name: c_birth_country
columns.description: Stores the birth country of customers (up to 50 characters), represented by CHILE, TOGO, NIUE, MEXICO, FIJI.

columns.name: c_login
columns.description: Stores customer login credentials as text (assuming from context).

columns.name: c_email_address
columns.description: Stores customer email addresses up to 50 characters, including domain names.

columns.name: c_last_review_date_sk
columns.description: Stores sequential identifiers of customer's last review dates.
